title: Determinant expansion by permutations
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix. Form the polynomial matrix whose $(i,j)$ entry is $X_{i,j}$ when $A_{i,j}=\mathrm{true}$ and zero otherwise. Its determinant is the sum over all permutations $\sigma$ of the indices of $\operatorname{sgn}(\sigma)$ times $\prod_i M_{i,\sigma(i)}$, where $M$ is this polynomial matrix and the sign is viewed as a polynomial over $R$.
